##### Project general facts

Zeta by Acube Developments is a contemporary residential development located in the rapidly growing community of Dubai. Comprising 147 thoughtfully designed residences across 13 residential floors, the project offers a collection of fully furnished studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, all featuring private balconies and smart home readiness. Selected residences are further enhanced with private jacuzzis, creating an elevated living experience that seamlessly combines comfort, functionality, and modern design.

Designed to promote an active and well-balanced lifestyle, Zeta features over 30 premium amenities spread across two dedicated leisure floors. Residents will enjoy a sky pool, state-of-the-art gym, multifunction hall, amphitheatre, outdoor mini golf, arcade, BBQ area, social lounge, and dedicated indoor and outdoor children's play areas. The development also offers attractive payment plans, making it an appealing opportunity for both homeowners and investors seeking contemporary living in one of Dubai's emerging residential destinations.

##### Location description and benefits

Liwan, situated in the heart of Dubai, is a dynamic and well-integrated residential community that offers a harmonious blend of modern living, convenience, and tranquility. Designed to provide residents with a holistic lifestyle, Liwan boasts a wide array of amenities and facilities that cater to both practical needs and recreational desires.

The community is characterized by its thoughtfully planned infrastructure, spacious landscaped parks, and pedestrian-friendly pathways, promoting a sense of connectivity and community engagement. With a mix of residential options including apartments and townhouses, Liwan caters to various family sizes and lifestyles.

Liwan's central location ensures easy access to major road networks, making commuting and exploring the city a breeze. The presence of schools, mosques, retail centers, and recreational spaces within the community emphasizes its self-sustained nature, offering residents everything they need right at their doorstep.
